mentions.name: Email-based AI agent runner
mentions.description: This tool keeps AI agents running through email while the user is away from their desk, letting agents continue working unattended instead of needing to be babysat.
mentions.problem: The author wants agents to keep working while away from the desk, without babysitting them, so they can spend time on the moments that matter.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a way to keep my agents running using email while I'm away from my desk. I want to spend time with the moments that matter, not babysitting agents. I want them to keep working while I'm out. Why can't I just email them?
